About

Every voyage is a promise between people and the sea.

Stars are direction. Seas are the journey. Technology is protection. Responsibility is the way home.

Brand Story

Eastar Map believes technology should not make navigation more complicated. It should turn complex chart information, navigation data, and risk factors into clearer, more readable, and more reliable decision support.

“Stars above. Seas ahead.” is not only a slogan. It is how Eastar Map understands the mission of navigation technology.
